placeBlurb: Home to some of the largest sand dunes on earth — an otherworldly landscape of mega-dunes and silence. At sunset the ridges turn gold and the whole horizon goes quiet.
bortleCopy: The scale runs 1–9, where 1 is the darkest sky on earth and 9 is an inner city. At Bortle 2 the Milky Way is plainly visible — the tonal palette of this tee comes from the last hour of light before it arrives.
designIntro: This one is embroidered rather than printed — thread laid into the fabric, tonal against the cloth rather than shouting against it. It is the quietest piece in the collection, and the one that reads best up close.

designCards.title: The sun over the ridges
designCards.body: A low sun setting across the dune lines of Liwa, worked in tonal thread so it catches the light rather than the eye.

designCards.title: Beneath it
designCards.body: A small صحراء mark — Arabic for "desert" — the same signature that runs through the collection.

designCards.title: Why sand
designCards.body: The colourway is pulled from the dunes themselves at golden hour, so the embroidery sits tone-on-tone instead of fighting the fabric.

printCardBody: Thread stitched into the cloth gives a subtle raised texture you can feel. It won't fade or crack the way a print eventually can — embroidery ages differently, and better.
careIntro: Embroidery is hardier than print, but the thread still appreciates a gentle wash.
care: Machine wash cold, inside out — this protects the stitching from abrasion.
Wash with similar colours, on a gentle cycle.
Hang to dry. Tumble drying is the main cause of shrinkage and puckering around stitching.
Iron inside out, avoiding the embroidery directly — never press a hot iron onto thread.
Skip bleach and fabric softener; softener coats the fibres and dulls the finish.
Watch for snags — embroidery can catch on velcro and rough surfaces.

faq.q: How is embroidery different from a printed tee?
faq.a: Embroidery is thread stitched into the fabric rather than ink applied to it. It has a subtle raised texture you can feel, it catches light differently through the day, and it won't crack or fade the way a print eventually can. It is also quieter — tonal rather than high-contrast.

faq.q: Are these unisex? Will they fit women?
faq.a: Yes — every piece we make is cut unisex, in one run of sizes from S to XL. There is no separate men's or women's version and no difference in the cut. Because the size chart lists the garment measured flat rather than a body size, the reliable way to choose is to measure a t-shirt you already like the fit of and match the numbers. Plenty of people size down for a closer fit or up for a relaxed one — both are the same garment.

The fabric is pre-washed to minimise shrinkage. Wash cold and hang dry and you should see very little movement. Hot washes and tumble dryers are what cause shrinkage — and with embroidery, tumble drying can also pucker the fabric around the stitching.

It's a heavyweight tee, so it's more substantial than a thin fast-fashion shirt — that's what gives it structure and longevity. It's 100% breathable cotton, and because this design is embroidered rather than printed there is no film across the fabric at all. For peak summer, the Regular fit breathes more than the Oversized.

faq.q: What if I order the wrong size?
faq.a: Exchanges within the UAE are free, subject to stock, within 14 days of delivery — as long as it's unworn, unwashed and still has tags. Email hello@sahraandbeyond.ae with your order number and we'll arrange it.
This is a limited first run. We may make more of a design later, but we don't promise it — when a size sells out in this run, treat it as gone.

fitWho: Take your normal t-shirt size. Regular is the one to choose if you layer under a shacket or jacket, if you run warm, or if you want the design to sit flat across the chest and back rather than drape. The shoulder seam lands where your shoulder actually ends.
